n: <int> Number of customers to be served.
T: <int> Number of time periods in the planning horizon.
m: <int> Number of identical vehicles available at the plant.
Q: <int> Maximum load capacity of each vehicle.
C: <int> Maximum production quantity at the plant per period.
f: <float> Fixed cost incurred whenever production takes place in a period.
u: <float> Cost per unit of product produced at the plant.
epsilon: <float> Half-width of the demand uncertainty interval as a fraction of nominal demand.
alpha_hat: <int> Multiplier used to compute the per-unit penalty cost for unmet customer demand.
coordinates: <list[list[float]], shape [n+1][2]> Spatial coordinates of each node, where index 0 is the plant and indices 1 through n are customers.
transportation_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [n+1][n+1]> Symmetric travel cost between each pair of nodes, where index 0 is the plant.
h: <list[float], length n+1> Per-unit inventory holding cost at each node per period, where index 0 is the plant.
L: <list[int], length n+1> Maximum inventory storage capacity at each node, where index 0 is the plant.
I0: <list[int], length n+1> Inventory on hand at each node at the start of the planning horizon, where index 0 is the plant.
d_bar: <list[list[int]], shape [n][T]> Nominal (expected) demand for each customer in each period.
sigma: <list[float], length n> Per-unit penalty cost for unmet demand at each customer.
scenario_probabilities: <list[float], length n_scenarios> Probability of each demand scenario being realized.
demand_scenarios: <list[list[list[float]]], shape [n_scenarios][n][T]> Realized demand for each customer in each period under each scenario.
